# forgebase_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project and its environments by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_project" "web" {
  id = "prj_abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project id.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `org` (String) Organization id, if any.
- `realm_id` (String) Realm.
- `slug` (String) Slug.
